text_en: When Judith had stopped crying out to the God of Israel, and had ended all these words,
text_cn: 友弟德呼吁以色列的天主，祝告了这一切话以后，

text_en: she rose from where she lay prostrate. She called her maid and went down into the house where she lived on sabbaths and on her festal days.
text_cn: 就由地上起来，叫来自己的使女，一同下到她安息日及庆节日所常住的屋里，

text_en: She removed the sackcloth she had been wearing, took off her widow’s garments, bathed her body with water, and anointed herself with precious ointment. She combed her hair, put on a tiara, and dressed herself in the festive attire that she used to wear while her husband Manasseh was living.
text_cn: 除去所穿的苦衣，脱下寡妇的衣服，洗了澡，涂上贵重的香水，梳好头发，蒙上手帕，穿上丈夫默纳舍在世时自己喜爱穿的锦衣，

text_en: She put sandals on her feet, and put on her anklets, bracelets, rings, earrings, and all her other jewelry. Thus she made herself very beautiful, to entice the eyes of all the men who might see her.
text_cn: 脚穿凉鞋，挂上项链、带上手镯、指环、耳环，以及各种装饰品；打扮得花枝招展，令男人见了，无不注目而视。

text_en: She gave her maid a skin of wine and a flask of oil, and filled a bag with roasted grain, dried fig cakes, and fine bread; then she wrapped up all her dishes and gave them to her to carry.
text_cn: 然后拿了一皮囊酒，一瓶油，交给自己的使女；又在一布袋内装满了烘焙的大麦，无花果糕，净面包；将一切物品包在一起，放在使女肩上背着。

text_en: Then they went out to the town gate of Bethulia and found Uzziah standing there with the elders of the town, Chabris and Charmis.
text_cn: 于是二人出发，走向拜突里雅城门，正遇见敖齐雅及城中长老加布黎和加尔米在那里等候。

text_en: When they saw her transformed in appearance and dressed differently, they were very greatly astounded at her beauty and said to her,
text_cn: 他们见她容貌大变，服装特异，赞叹她的美丽，对她说：

text_en: “May the God of our ancestors grant you favor and fulfill your plans, so that the people of Israel may glory and Jerusalem may be exalted. ” She bowed down to God.
text_cn: “愿我们祖先的天主，使你蒙恩，使以色列子民欢乐，使耶路撒冷显扬！愿他完成你的计划！”

text_en: Then she said to them, “Order the gate of the town to be opened for me so that I may go out and accomplish the things you have just said to me. ” So they ordered the young men to open the gate for her, as she requested.
text_cn: 友弟德遂朝拜了天主，以后向他们说：“请你们下令给我开城门，我要出去，完成你们对我说的事。”长老遂吩咐少年人，照她说的为她开门。

text_en: When they had done this, Judith went out, accompanied by her maid. The men of the town watched her until she had gone down the mountain and passed through the valley, where they lost sight of her.
text_cn: 他们开了城门，友弟德和她的婢女就出去了；城里的人目送她下山；等她转过了山谷，就看不见她了。

text_en: As the women were going straight on through the valley, an Assyrian patrol met her
text_cn: 她二人在山谷内一直前行，迎面来了一个亚述的哨兵，

text_en: and took her into custody. They asked her, “To what people do you belong, and where are you coming from, and where are you going? ” She replied, “I am a daughter of the Hebrews, but I am fleeing from them, for they are about to be handed over to you to be devoured.
text_cn: 就捉住她，盘问说：“你是哪国人，从哪里来，往哪里去？”她答说：“我是希伯来人。我从他们那里偷跑出来，因为他们快要落在你们口里。

text_en: I am on my way to see Holofernes the commander of your army, to give him a true report; I will show him a way by which he can go and capture all the hill country without losing one of his men, captured or slain. ”
text_cn: 我来见你们军队的统帅敖罗斐乃，我带有真实情报，要指给他一条路，从这条路进攻，不损一兵一卒，就能占领这山地。”

text_en: When the men heard her words, and observed her face—she was in their eyes marvelously beautiful—they said to her,
text_cn: 那些人听她说话时，都目不转睛的看着她，见了这样美丽的女人，都惊讶称奇，对她说：

text_en: “You have saved your life by hurrying down to see our lord. Go at once to his tent; some of us will escort you and hand you over to him.
text_cn: “你救了命，因你迅速下来，投奔我们的主帅；如今你到他帐幕里去，我们必有人送你，将你交在他手里。

text_en: When you stand before him, have no fear in your heart, but tell him what you have just said, and he will treat you well. ”
text_cn: 若你站在他面前时，你心里不要害怕，只要你按你的话报告，他必定会优待你。”

text_en: They chose from their number a hundred men to accompany her and her maid, and they brought them to the tent of Holofernes.
text_cn: 人就从队里，挑选了一百人，护送她和她的使女，到敖罗斐乃的帐幕前。

text_en: There was great excitement in the whole camp, for her arrival was reported from tent to tent. They came and gathered around her as she stood outside the tent of Holofernes, waiting until they told him about her.
text_cn: 一时全营齐集，因为她前来的消息已传遍了各帐幕；人出来将她围住。那时她正站在敖罗斐乃的帐幕外，等着往上传禀她的事。

text_en: They marveled at her beauty and admired the Israelites, judging them by her. They said to one another, “Who can despise these people, who have women like this among them? It is not wise to leave one of their men alive, for if we let them go they will be able to beguile the whole world! ”
text_cn: 人对她的花容玉貌，无不赞叹，也因她而赞叹以色列子民，彼此相告说：“这民族既有这样的美人，谁还能轻视？他们中即便只让一个男人生存，也不是好事；任他们自由，他们必能智取全世界。”

text_en: Then the guards of Holofernes and all his servants came out and led her into the tent.
text_cn: 敖罗斐乃的护卫和众仆从出来，领她进入营幕。

text_en: Holofernes was resting on his bed under a canopy that was woven with purple and gold, emeralds and other precious stones.
text_cn: 那时敖罗斐乃，正在金玉珠宝装饰的紫帐内的床上休息。

text_en: When they told him of her, he came to the front of the tent, with silver lamps carried before him.
text_cn: 人们将她的事向他禀告之后，他遂由银灯引导，来到帐幕门口。

text_en: When Judith came into the presence of Holofernes and his servants, they all marveled at the beauty of her face. She prostrated herself and did obeisance to him, but his slaves raised her up.
text_cn: 友弟德一来到他和他的侍从面前，他们无不赞赏她的花容玉貌。友弟德遂俯伏在地，向他致敬，侍役们即将她扶起。
